rationale: Facebook's terms employ moderately transparent license language for user content while obscuring the true transaction: extensive behavioral data harvesting in exchange for revocable platform access. Severe unilateral termination rights, broad liability waivers capped at $100, and expansive off-platform surveillance create heavily one-sided obligations that disadvantage users significantly.
evidence_quotes: If we determine that you have clearly, seriously or repeatedly breached our Terms or Policies...we may suspend or permanently disable access to your account
Our aggregate liability will not exceed the greater of $100 or the amount you have paid us in the past twelve months
we use the data we have—for example...what you share and do on and off our Products
We make no guarantees that they always will be safe, secure, or error-free, or that they will function without disruptions
to provide our services we need you to give us some legal permissions (known as a 'license')
